portraits.name: glass-dewberry
portraits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached single botanical plant portrait for a Stardew Valley mod. Change ONLY the foliage shape and spacing, keep the species, large harvest parts, vivid colors, attractive hand-painted fantasy-game rendering and single tall upright plant. The user wants much more sweeping, spreading foliage and a clearer contour. Make the leaves conspicuously broader, thick-bodied and curved, fanning outward to the left and right in confident sweeping arcs. Every major leaf blade must have a wide solid midsection, with a strongly readable pointed tip. Alternate 4-6 large leaves, in open spaced tiers with visible gaps and visible stem segments between them; spread the foliage nearly to the same lateral extent as the fruits/flowers. A loose lively S-curve and asymmetric outward leaf fans, not compact little bunches, not tiny twigs. Leaf blades need simple large light planes over rich emerald colored shadows, clean firm deep-green edges, no blur or wispy hairlines. Their shapes must still read after reduction to 14 by 26 pixels inside a 16 by 32 crop cell. Preserve generous flower/fruit size; do not reduce them to make room. Keep a tall silhouette approximately 1:2 width to height, full plant visible with a small transparent margin all around. Truly transparent RGBA background, no ground, no cast shadow, no border, no text, no other objects. Dark outline is colored and moderate, never a heavy black ring. Preserve exactly THREE large round luminous blue/cyan glass berries with cobalt shadows and ivory highlights at staggered heights, and one curving green main stem. Broaden the teal-green leaves especially between the berries and at the base, so foliage forms wide separated side sweeps instead of hugging the stem.
